LuckyWorld Hardcore

Introduction

In this modpack, you must defeat the Ender Dragon using the luck from lucky blocks. Prepare to harness the power of luck to overcome the dragon, as you'll need it to succeed. Along the way, you may face challenging mobs that keep you on your toes.

Features

  • Optimized gameplay for a smoother experience.
  • Custom quests to guide your adventure.
  • Hardcore mobs that present tough challenges.
  • A wide variety of lucky blocks to enhance your play.
